name: Sony XM5

description: Battery and controls for the Sony WH-1000XM5 and WF-1000XM5

barWidget.description: Battery, noise control and equaliser for the WH-1000XM5 and WF-1000XM5

schema.label: Bluetooth address
schema.description: Only read while mdrctld is stopped, so BlueZ knows which device to report battery for. Leave empty while the daemon runs -- it reports its own address. Find yours with: bluetoothctl devices Connected

schema.label: Display name
schema.description: Shown in the panel header until the headset reports its own model.
